To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed an approach for extracting and summarizing the most relevant information in software development video tutorials.

(i) developers are interested in extracting fragments from videos to learn new technologies; (ii) developers are interested to search video fragments based on their contents; and (iii) developers are willing to pay for a service that extracts relevant fragments from videos.

(1) we can extract relevant fragments from video tutorials based on a set of keywords, (2) we can identify relevant fragments based on the content of the video tutorials, (3) we can identify the relevance of fragments by comparing their content with other fragments, and (4) we can identify fragments that are relevant for a specific developer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the extraction of relevant fragments from video tutorials, which we refer to as CodeTube.
the problem of extracting relevant fragments from video tutorials, and presenting them to the developer in a way that facilitates the learning process.
extracting relevant fragments from video tutorials and providing them as an alternative to the full video.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the code is not the only thing that matters in the software industry.
video tutorials are a valuable resource for developers, but the current practice of using them is cumbersome and time-consuming, which hinders their adoption.
video tutorials are a good source of informal documentation, and they can be made searchable by using the techniques proposed in this paper.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an approach to automatically generate a summary of video tutorial content.
we propose a method for extracting relevant fragments of a video tutorial and present a tool to visualize these fragments.
we developed an approach to extract relevant fragments from video tutorials, based on a combination of visual and textual features.
The main takeaway from our work is that
developers can benefit from a video search engine, which is able to extract relevant fragments of the tutorial, given a query.
developers can be assisted in finding relevant fragments of a software development video tutorial, based on their search query.
it is possible to extract relevant fragments from video tutorials based on a combination of visual and textual features.
